reasons.detail: supplied source bytes do not reproduce the declared identities

statuses.non_comparable: a comparability check failed; no outcomes
statuses.conditionally_comparable: all checks passed; outcomes are diagnostics qualified by the listed gaps
statuses.verified_comparable: all checks passed and every input link, including per-case input, label and family, is verified

input_provenance.description: Invented SOU-153 control source. Inputs and run outcomes are generated by paired_regression_controls.py to test the comparator's accounting; not AgentDojo, not a measurement and not evidence of any execution.

run_to_plan.method: each run's plan_sha256 equals the SHA-256 of its supplied plan bytes

case_semantic_input.method: a case manifest inside the inventoried src/ maps every case ID to its user task and environment files, expected label and semantic family; these agree with the plan, and the per-case full-input hash is identical for both sides

candidate: source inventory not reproduced for this side, so the case manifest is not bound to its run

source_to_inventory.method: bundle src/ bytes reproduce the plan's and the run's recorded source_inventory_sha256 with the producer's verify_checkout composition

candidate: source inventory recomputed from the bundle differs from the plan
source inventory recomputed from the bundle differs from the inventory recorded by the run

injections_to_plan.method: injection strings of every attacked case reproduce its planned injections_sha256 and vectors

provenance.description: Invented SOU-153 control source. Inputs and run outcomes are generated by paired_regression_controls.py to test the comparator's accounting; not AgentDojo, not a measurement and not evidence of any execution.

input_binding.scope: identity of the supplied inputs; not proof that the producer executed them
residual_trust: the run's inventory hash is the producer's own runtime record
run-level settings, model and runtime are compared between sides only

pins.note: pins are producer declarations checked for run/plan consistency

definitions.planned: case x repetition units in the frozen plan set
definitions.attempted: units whose execution started: evaluable, unknown, or stopped there
definitions.evaluable: units with an enforced trajectory and recorded evaluator outcomes
definitions.unknown: recorded enforced trajectories whose evaluator outcome a bound annotation declares unknown
definitions.incomplete: the unit where the run stopped; evaluators were not reported

timeouts.reason: the producer wraps provider transport errors, including timeouts, in AdapterError with reason provider_failure; reason and error_type are kept verbatim per stopped unit
the producer wraps provider transport errors, including timeouts, in AdapterError with reason provider_failure; reason and error_type are kept verbatim per stopped unit

unknown.reason: matched/1 rows carry Boolean evaluator outputs only; the producer reports no unknown outcome. Ask (approval_required) is reported separately and is not unknown.

limitations: Development comparison of recorded runs; not held-out efficacy, general safety or pilot readiness evidence.
Revision pins and the run's source inventory hash are producer declarations; this tool checks their consistency, not which binary or policy actually executed.

Input binding checks the identity of the supplied inputs, not that the producer executed them. Per-case full input, label and family are verified only through a case manifest inside the inventoried source; without one that link stays unverified (genuine upstream AgentDojo has none).

Paired differences are conditional on units evaluable in both runs; with partial coverage only the missing-outcome bounds on the planned set account for missing outcomes; they are not confidence intervals.
Without declared semantic families, correlated variants are grouped by known plan dependencies only.
Unknown outcomes are unavailable in this producer contract; timeouts are not distinguishable.
Checkpoint scope: family-aware uncertainty and latency distributions are not computed yet.
